macros.name: cpxAdd
macros.doc: Defines complex number c obtained by adding complex numbers a and b.

macros.name: cpxDiv
macros.doc: Defines complex number f obtained by dividing complex number a by b.

macros.name: cpxIm
macros.doc: Defines j as an imaginary part of complex number a.

macros.name: cpxInv
macros.doc: Defines complex number g obtained by taking inverse of complex number a.

macros.name: cpxMod
macros.doc: Defines m as modulus of complex number a.

macros.name: cpxMul
macros.doc: Defines complex number e obtained by multiplying complex number a by b.

macros.name: cpxNew
macros.doc: A complex number can be defined by using the \cpxNew command.

macros.name: cpxOp
macros.doc: Defines n as a resulting complex number by performing some operations on \cpxOp{n}{some operations} complex numbers.

macros.name: cpxPrinArg
macros.doc: Defines p as the principal argument of complex number a.

macros.name: cpxRe
macros.doc: Defines h as a real part of complex number a.

macros.name: cpxSub
macros.doc: Defines complex number d obtained by subtracting complex number b from a.

macros.name: imgUnit
macros.doc: The package has a command \imgUnit which provides typesetting for the imaginary unit.
